#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import sys
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

AUTHORIZED_FROM = "noreply@system.internal.example"

def send_email(to, subject, body, sender=AUTHORIZED_FROM, reply_to=None):
    host = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "127.0.0.1")
    port = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", 2525))
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = sender
    msg["To"] = to
    if reply_to:
        msg["Reply-To"] = reply_to
    msg["Subject"] = subject
    msg.set_content(body)
    with smtplib.SMTP(host, port) as server:
        server.send_message(msg)

def send_system_notice():
    send_email(
        to="admin@system.internal.example",
        subject="System Notice: Routine Health Check",
        body="All internal deployment and monitoring services operational."
    )
    print("System notice sent.")
    return 0

def send_contact():
    print("Error: contact command not yet implemented.")
    return 1

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: mailer.py [contact|system-notice]")
        sys.exit(1)
    cmd = sys.argv[1]
    if cmd == "system-notice":
        sys.exit(send_system_notice())
    elif cmd == "contact":
        sys.exit(send_contact())
    else:
        print(f"Unknown command: {cmd}")
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import sys
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

AUTHORIZED_FROM = "noreply@system.internal.example"
SUPPORT_TO = "support@system.internal.example"

def send_email(to, subject, body, sender=AUTHORIZED_FROM, reply_to=None):
    host = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "127.0.0.1")
    port = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", 2525))
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = sender
    msg["To"] = to
    if reply_to:
        msg["Reply-To"] = reply_to
    msg["Subject"] = subject
    msg.set_content(body)
    with smtplib.SMTP(host, port) as server:
        server.send_message(msg)

def send_system_notice():
    send_email(
        to="admin@system.internal.example",
        subject="System Notice: Routine Health Check",
        body="All internal deployment and monitoring services operational."
    )
    print("System notice sent.")
    return 0

def send_contact():
    user_email = os.environ.get("USER_EMAIL", "").strip()
    user_name = os.environ.get("USER_NAME", "").strip()
    user_message = os.environ.get("USER_MESSAGE", "")

    missing = [
        name
        for name, value in (
            ("USER_EMAIL", user_email),
            ("USER_NAME", user_name),
            ("USER_MESSAGE", user_message),
        )
        if not value
    ]
    if missing:
        print(f"Error: missing required environment variable(s): {', '.join(missing)}")
        return 1

    send_email(
        to=SUPPORT_TO,
        subject=f"Support Request from {user_name}",
        body=(
            "A user submitted a support request.\n\n"
            f"Name: {user_name}\n"
            f"Email: {user_email}\n\n"
            "Message:\n"
            f"{user_message}"
        ),
        reply_to=user_email,
    )
    print("Contact support email sent.")
    return 0

def main():
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print("Usage: mailer.py [contact|system-notice]")
        sys.exit(1)
    cmd = sys.argv[1]
    if cmd == "system-notice":
        sys.exit(send_system_notice())
    elif cmd == "contact":
        sys.exit(send_contact())
    else:
        print(f"Unknown command: {cmd}")
        sys.exit(1)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os
import mailer

sent = []

class FakeSMTP:
    def __init__(self, host, port):
        self.host = host
        self.port = port
    def __enter__(self):
        return self
    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc, tb):
        return False
    def send_message(self, msg):
        sent.append((self.host, self.port, msg))

mailer.smtplib.SMTP = FakeSMTP

os.environ.update({
    'USER_EMAIL': 'user@example.com',
    'USER_NAME': 'Test User',
    'USER_MESSAGE': 'Please help me with my account.',
    'SMTP_HOST': 'smtp.test.local',
    'SMTP_PORT': '2526',
})
assert mailer.send_contact() == 0
host, port, msg = sent[-1]
assert host == 'smtp.test.local'
assert port == 2526
assert msg['From'] == mailer.AUTHORIZED_FROM
assert msg['To'] == mailer.SUPPORT_TO
assert msg['Reply-To'] == 'user@example.com'
assert msg['Subject'] == 'Support Request from Test User'
body = msg.get_content()
assert 'Name: Test User' in body
assert 'Email: user@example.com' in body
assert 'Please help me with my account.' in body

assert mailer.send_system_notice() == 0
_, _, notice = sent[-1]
assert notice['To'] == 'admin@system.internal.example'
assert notice['Subject'] == 'System Notice: Routine Health Check'
print('smoke tests passed')
